title: The Vanishing Order
subtitle: An exception disappears. So does an order.
description: An order processor crashes on a blank quantity. Does catching the exception actually fix it?
contract: Blank quantity means one. Explicit zero stays zero. Preserve every order, its identifier, and its position. Never modify the input.

sources.original:
def transform(rows):
    return [{"id": r["id"], "total_cents": int(r["quantity"]) * r["unit_cents"]} for r in rows]
